summary: The question asks someone’s location. In Genesis 3:9 God addresses the man directly. In Genesis 4:9 he asks Cain where Abel is.

senses.definition: Ask the location of a person identified by name or by a pronominal suffix.

evidence.note: God calls to the man. The suffix in אַיֶּכָּה identifies him as the person being asked, “Where are you?”
In אֵי הֶבֶל אָחִיךָ, “Where is Abel your brother?”, the name follows the interrogative.
